September 21, 2005
Analysis by Richard Cowan
See
 The Washington Post and The Evil of Banality. "Only the hypocrite is really rotten to the core.
and
 Medical Marijuana And The Banality of Evil In A San Francisco Courtroom

Yesterday, Canada, or rather a bureaucrat acting on its behalf, rejected Steve Tuck's request that it assess the risk he would face if forced to return to DEAland.

Steve was understandably disturbed by this version of Here's a quarter. Call somebody who cares. No human life should be dismissed with such incompetence and indifference to the truth, but there is nothing personal here Or is there?

We will have to respond in full very soon with another appeal to the courts and I will share most of it with you at that point, but here is just one example that demonstrates what I mean about the banality of evil.

In his request for a Pre-Removal Risk Assessment (PRRA) Tuck was only allowed to raise points that are subsequent to the rejection of his first appeal to the Courts earlier this year. Thus, there was no reference to his medical condition in the PRRA.

Nonetheless, in rejecting the PRRA, some bureaucrat could write, With respect to the issue of his medical condition, I find the applicant has provided insufficient medical evidence that marijuana is required in the course of his treatment. Whether this pain and condition requires treatment with marijuana has not been established by the applicant, beyond his personal assertions

That seems reasonable, and so one might then wonder why Steve had provided insufficient medical evidence that marijuana is required in the course of his treatment.

What is Canadian for Catch 22?

The problem arose at the beginning of the refugee process when Immigration Canada made very clear that they would accept only the opinion of a specialist of their own choosing. But they refused to appoint any such specialist!

In other words, because they refused to appoint anyone there is no acceptable Canadian medical opinion on Steve's condition. And now they try to blame him for having provided insufficient medical evidence.

Perhaps we can improve on the old saying, There are none so blind as those who will not see. Should it be: There are none so blind as those who refuse even to look.

I suspect that IC would not appoint a specialist for Tuck because the specialist that they chose for Steve Kubby confirmed his cancer diagnosis and approved of his use of cannabis to treat it. Of course, that did not stop them from trying to undermine their own expert and send Kubby to his death, but it did complicate things.

Our next move:
When Tuck began his first judicial appeal, his attorney advised that it might be best if there was less publicity, so I naturally wrote much less about his case. Unfortunately, we now know that that did not work and so when he makes this appeal to the Canadian courts we are going to tell the full story and it may get nasty.

Canada has repeatedly violated its own laws and Tuck's rights in dealing with him. When he first came up here he gave Health Canada a huge quantity of seeds for their medical cannabis program, and then tried to pretend it did not happen. Steve has never forced the issue, until now. This is a story that will embarrass a lot of people and may pose yet another challenge to all Canadian marijuana laws.
See
 Philippe Lucas Analysis of the Consequences of Health Canada's Failure to Obey the Ontario Court's Ruling On Medical Cannabis. Is Cannabis Legal in Canada?

The real Golden Rule:
However, that is nothing compared with the scandal that will erupt if he sues the RCMP for violating his rights and the really sacred Canadian mining laws.
See
 Kubby and Tuck Allowed to Appeal Denial of Refugee Status. Canadian Law Enforcement Violates The Law With Multiple Attacks On Tuck. Hayes Simply Takes Leave.

Before Steve studied botany and then became interested in a certain plant, he had studied geology, because of his interest in caves. Thinking that Canada might stop collaborating with DEAland's attempts to kill him, Steve started exploring for mining prospects near Vancouver.

The results have been spectacular and the stakes are going to be mind-boggling. Steve is no longer just one more disabled person who can be quietly murdered by the banality of evil. He is now the discoverer of several world-class mining properties.

Over the next few weeks, you will be hearing a lot more about this about Steve's case here on MarijuanaNews and about the mines in the business news. The company is privately owned, but the implications of Steve's discoveries will be important to the mining industry here and around the world.

The most recent assays are now available online at http://ashlumines.com/assays-N-charts-page3.htm these numbers will not mean anything to the average person, but to those in the mining business will understand.

(By way of a disclaimer, I have a small interest in this company, but my real interest remains in beating the bastards. Yesterday shattered the last of my illusions.)

Obviously, owning a gold mine or whatever has no direct bearing on the refugee question, but it will get the lights turned on. That is all we really need.

Canada must look at the evil that is being committed in its name by its bureaucracy. It is run by a clique of preening hypocrites who call themselves Liberals, but the best description of Canada that I have seen recently calls it the glossiest, the most sophisticated and the most up-to-date version of the illiberal state. Canadians must take back their country, not just from the US, but from this soulless machine.
See
 Faux Canada! Phony Decrim Bill Dead Until Next Parliament. Phony Medical Cannabis Program Still Ignores Courts. Collaboration With DEA Puts American Medical Users in Danger, But No Asylum.
and

and

and
